ai_notice.description: Always set by the server: the reply comes from an AI system.

kind.description: Always set by the server on new replies: answer, emergency (call emergency services, no graph answer) or declined (part of the question crossed the medical boundary and was declined; graph context may still follow). Null only on replies stored before this field existed.

profile_hints.description: Unconfirmed age, onset and country extracted from this turn, and whether the message seems to be about a child. Null when nothing was found.

symptom_match.description: Conditions ranked by symptom overlap when match_phenotypes ran this turn (symptoms-only messages), built by the server from the tool result. Null otherwise and on replies stored before this field existed.

explanation.title: Explanation
explanation.description: Why an inferred link exists (one line, a hypothesis); null if absent.

orcid_id.title: Orcid Id
orcid_id.description: Public ORCID iD of the node, if any.

orcid_id.description: Public ORCID iD of the node, if any.

matched_by.description: orcid: exact ORCID iD; name_and_institution: same name and a shared institution; name: same name only.

AtlasLayout.description: Compact whole-graph layout for the Atlas view.

orcid_id.title: Orcid Id
orcid_id.description: ORCID iD, 0000-0000-0000-000X, with a valid check digit.

AtlasMatchRequest.description: A draft of the work details to look up candidate atlas entries. Nothing is stored.

label.title: Label
label.description: From the current atlas; null if it left the atlas.

data_version.title: Data Version
data_version.description: Data version the counts were computed from.

links_cited.title: Links Cited
links_cited.description: Links with origin observed (backed by a source).

AtlasStats.title: AtlasStats
AtlasStats.description: Headline counts of the loaded graph, computed once per data version.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: focus: on the map, with literature, trials and people collected; core: findable (genes, symptoms, computed links) but not on the map yet. The tier of a disease, gene, phenotype or pathway; focus for every other node type.

focus_disease_count.title: Focus Disease Count
focus_disease_count.description: How many diseases have the full set of literature, trials and people.

AuthProvider.title: AuthProvider
AuthProvider.description:
How an account signs in: openai (Sign in with ChatGPT) or google. One account per
provider identity; accounts are never merged by e-mail.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name snapshot of the blocked person.

file.title: File
file.description: PDF, PNG, JPEG, HEIC, DOCX or plain text; max 20 MB, 30 pages.

adults_only.title: Adults Only
adults_only.description: min_age is 18 or more: show 'for adults'.

registry_url.title: Registry Url
registry_url.description: Link to the public registry entry.

publisher.description: The publisher's public card ('run by [name], [institution]'). Always set on published calls in the list; null on the publisher's own view while their card is hidden.

demo.title: Demo
demo.description: Seeded demo data: label it 'Demo, not a real study'.

self_published.title: Self Published
self_published.description: The expert published it without a review by the Amber team (CALLS_REVIEW_REQUIRED off).

review_badge.title: Review Badge
review_badge.description: Show on every published call, exactly as sent: either the review badge or, for a self-published call, that it was not reviewed. On the publisher's unpublished calls it is the badge the call would get when it goes live.
review_badge.default: Reviewed by the Amber team for wording, ethics and registry numbers, not for scientific quality

notice.title: Notice
notice.default: Ask your doctor whether this trial or study could apply to you. This is not an eligibility check: only the study team decides who can take part.

summary.description: What the research is about and what it wants to find out.

eligibility_text.description: Who can take part, in the study team's words.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes where it runs; shown as information.

remote.title: Remote
remote.description: Can be done without visiting a site.

consent_active.title: Consent Active
consent_active.description: An active `connect` consent of the current text.

items.title: Items
items.description: Empty unless consent_active and enabled. Strongest first, then newest.

notice.title: Notice
notice.default: Suggestions compare the confirmed items of your profile with published calls, inside your own account. Nobody else sees them, and study teams never learn who was suggested. Every published call stays listed for everyone; suggestions only point to some of them.

items.title: Items
items.description: The matching atlas entries, labels from the atlas.

via_variant.title: Via Variant
via_variant.description: gene only: at least one gene came from a variant in the profile.

SuggestionReasonKind.title: SuggestionReasonKind
SuggestionReasonKind.description:
disease: an exact disease of the profile is a disease of the call (strong); gene: a gene
of the profile, or the gene of a profile variant, is a gene of the call; symptoms: at least
two exact symptoms (HPO ids) of the profile are symptoms of the call.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Suggestions are switched on (off by default).

consent_active.title: Consent Active
consent_active.description: An active `connect` consent of the current text.

notice.title: Notice
notice.default: Suggestions compare the confirmed items of your profile with published calls, inside your own account. Nobody else sees them, and study teams never learn who was suggested. Every published call stays listed for everyone; suggestions only point to some of them.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Switching on needs the connect consent (403 consent_required). Switching off deletes the call_match notifications.

SymptomMatch.title: SymptomMatch
SymptomMatch.description:
The symptom-overlap ranking of a turn (match_phenotypes), built in code from the tool
result: an overlap count per condition, never a probability or a diagnosis.

overlap.title: Overlap
overlap.description: How many of the user's symptoms are recorded for it.

of.title: Of
of.description: How many symptoms the user described (resolved to HPO terms).

on_map.title: On Map
on_map.description: Drawn on the Atlas map (the focus set); else a node page.

shared.title: Shared
shared.description: The shared symptoms with their edges.

absent.title: Absent
absent.description: Symptoms recorded for it that the user said are absent, with their edges.

SymptomMatchItem.title: SymptomMatchItem
SymptomMatchItem.description: A condition in the atlas whose recorded symptoms overlap the user's.

user_symptom.title: User Symptom
user_symptom.description: The user's symptom as its HPO term label.

recorded_as.title: Recorded As
recorded_as.description: The HPO term recorded for the condition.

match.title: Match
match.description: How the recorded term relates to the user's symptom.

edge_id.title: Edge Id
edge_id.description: The has_phenotype edge that records it (cite this).

SymptomMatchTerm.title: SymptomMatchTerm
SymptomMatchTerm.description: One of the user's symptoms recorded for a condition, with the link that records it.

ThreadExport.title: ThreadExport
ThreadExport.description: A thread I take part in, with my own messages only (the other side's are theirs).

items.title: Items
items.description: Most recent activity first; hidden excluded.

requests_waiting.title: Requests Waiting
requests_waiting.description: Requests waiting for me to accept or decline.

ThreadStatus.title: ThreadStatus
ThreadStatus.description:
requested: waiting for the professional; open; declined; closed (withdrawn consent, a
deleted account or a role change); blocked (one side blocked the other).

unread_count.title: Unread Count
unread_count.description: Messages from the other side since my last read.

can_send.title: Can Send
can_send.description: The thread is open and both people are still here.

can_respond.title: Can Respond
can_respond.description: A request waiting for me to accept or decline.

guardian_agreement_needed.title: Guardian Agreement Needed
guardian_agreement_needed.description: I am 16 or 17 and have not yet ticked the guardian checkbox in this thread: my next message must send `guardian_agreed: true`.

code.title: Code
code.description: The error event's code (an ErrorCode), or `interrupted` when the stream was cut before the turn ended.

message.title: Message
message.description: The error event's message. Never echoes user content.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: The status events the turn sent, in order.

TurnFailure.title: TurnFailure
TurnFailure.description: A turn that ended without an answer, stored as the live stream showed it.

tool.title: Tool
tool.description: Tool of the status event, if any.

message.title: Message
message.description: The status text the stream showed.

profile_url.title: Profile Url
profile_url.description: https link to a public staff or profile page.

VerificationRequestCreate.title: VerificationRequestCreate
VerificationRequestCreate.description: Manual review: the Amber team checks the institutional e-mail and the public profile.

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: role_verified: identity checked for this role.

orcid_id_confirmed.title: Orcid Id Confirmed
orcid_id_confirmed.description: The ORCID iD is confirmed and locked.

orcid_available.title: Orcid Available
orcid_available.description: ORCID sign-in can be started on this server.

orcid_simulated.title: Orcid Simulated
orcid_simulated.description: ORCID sign-in is the local simulated mock.

term.title: Term
term.description: The rule that matched, e.g. 'cure' or 'free medication'.

WordingIssue.title: WordingIssue
WordingIssue.description: A phrase the wording check does not allow (offers, promises or prices of a treatment).
